item.title: Appointments - Illinois Secretary of State
item.description: Call us at 800-252-8980 and select option 2. We're available Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Seniors can also visit one of our walk-in seniors only DMVs. Real ID Ready? Get your REAL ID at your DMV visit. Visit our REAL ID section to find out if you need one and how to get it.

item.title: Request Appointment | Cook County Health
item.description: Whether you’re seeking routine care or specialized treatment, scheduling your appointment with us is both simple and convenient. Our dedicated team of medical professionals is here to ensure you receive the exceptional care you deserve. Call (312) 864-0200 to make, change or cancel an appointment.

item.title: Appointments Chicago, Illinois (IL), Advocate Health
item.description: Make an appointment online with your LiveWell account. Search for a provider near you with our Find a Doctor tool. Get care after hours or if your provider isn’t available. Get safe virtual care from anywhere 24/7 for minor issues. Meet with your care team from the comfort of home or anywhere.

item.title: In-Person Appointments - IDES
item.description: To schedule an appointment, you must call the Scheduling Hotline at (217) 558-0401. You can also visit any IDES local workforce office to drop off a document. Each office is equipped with a dropbox which is checked each business day. No appointment is necessary to use a dropbox.
